Overview.Name: Vemula Kavitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian, avoids non-veg on Friday

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & sautéed vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & curd
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 1: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Late-night eating and fried foods can worsen cravings and slow fat loss.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or chicken before eating rice.
Get regular morning sunlight exposure to improve sleep quality, recovery and energy levels.
Simple home-cooked meals and consistent yoga will support steady fat loss and better energy.
